raw_responses.Bulgarian:
The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of six different methods—DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO—across three distinct domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis categorizes the domains in the order Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, while the vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, with major gridlines and labels at 2% intervals. Each domain contains six grouped bars, each corresponding to one of the methods, as indicated by the legend: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (blue with diagonal stripes), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (orange with diagonal stripes), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (green with diagonal stripes). Within each group, the bars are arranged in the same order as listed in the legend. In Mathverse, the DAPO+Self-reflection bar reaches approximately 56%, while the PPO bar is around 53.5%. In MMLU, DAPO+Self-reflection is near 57%, and PPO is approximately 54.5%. In Physics, DAPO+Self-reflection peaks at about 61%, and PPO is around 59%. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or additional annotations beyond the standard color and pattern coding.

raw_responses.Chinese:
This bar chart compares the accuracy percentages of six different algorithms—DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, GRPO, SRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO—across three distinct domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis categorizes the domains in left-to-right order: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents “Accuracy (%)”, scaled linearly from 50 to 62, with major tick marks at every 2 percentage points (50, 52, 54, 56, 58, 60, 62). Each domain contains a grouped set of six bars, each corresponding to one algorithm as indicated by the legend: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (diagonal-striped blue-gray), GRPO (diagonal-striped orange), SRPO (solid orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (diagonal-striped green). Within each group, the bars are arranged in the same order as listed in the legend. In Mathverse, the DAPO+Self-reflection bar reaches approximately 56.1%, DAPO is at 53.2%, GRPO at 53.5%, SRPO at 55.8%, PPO+Self-reflection at 54.5%, and PPO at 53.3%. In MMLU, DAPO+Self-reflection is at 57.0%, DAPO at 55.9%, GRPO at 55.8%, SRPO at 57.2%, PPO+Self-reflection at 56.2%, and PPO at 54.6%. In Physics, DAPO+Self-reflection peaks at approximately 61.0%, DAPO at 57.6%, GRPO at 58.2%, SRPO at 60.7%, PPO+Self-reflection at 59.1%, and PPO at 57.0%. The bars are not sorted by height within each group; instead, they maintain a consistent algorithm order across domains. No bars are visually emphasized with shadows, outlines, or annotations beyond their color and pattern coding.
